svg.title: Issue 3 — Page 4 — Panel 1: MW workshop late afternoon — Theodore split task
svg.desc: MW 35mm eye level. Cramped Victorian clockmaker workshop interior, late afternoon. Theodore sits at his small workbench against far wall, hands moving between two tasks — assigned mainspring in foreground light, own project (partially reassembled watch movement) half-hidden in shadow behind a clock case. Glances sideways toward main bench off-frame, expression split between obligation and stolen passion. Tools on wall pegs, shelves of clocks, brass and copper catching warm amber gaslight. Theodore's bench dimmer than rest. Private work done in margins.
svg.text: Mind that spring. If you snap the arbor,
